rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Every particle has an **antiparticle** — same mass, opposite charge — created in pairs from energy (≥ 2mc²) and annihilating into photons. Matter's building blocks: **quarks** (six flavours; u +⅔e, d −⅓e), which never appear free (**confinement**). **Baryons** = 3 quarks (proton uud = +e; neutron udd = 0); **mesons** = quark–antiquark pairs (pions); both are **hadrons** feeling the strong force.…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: - q_u = +⅔e; q_d = −⅓e - Proton = uud (+e); Neutron = udd (0) - Pair threshold: 2mc²

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Baryons = 3 quarks; mesons = quark + antiquark; leptons = elementary.**  ·  **No free quark has ever been isolated** — confinement holds them inside hadrons.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ***Proton = uud*** — quark charges sum to +e; ***neutron = udd*** — sums to zero.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: **Every particle has an antiparticle** — same mass, opposite charge; the photon is its own antiparticle.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: u (+⅔e), d (−⅓e); proton uud, neutron udd; neutrinos weakly interacting.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: About 10¹⁴ solar neutrinos pass through your body every second without a single interaction.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — The Periodic Table of Matter Itself Atoms are not elementary: protons and neutrons are built from **quarks**, and a whole zoo of particles — baryons, mesons, leptons, neutrinos — populates the Standard Model. Every particle has an **antiparticle**; matter is the survivor of an almost perfect matter–antimatter cancellation.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts ### 2.1 Particles and antiparticles Every particle has an **antiparticle** with the same mass but opposite charge (and opposite quantum numbers): electron–positron, proton–antiproton, neutron–antineutron, photon (its own antiparticle). Particle–antiparticle pairs can be created from energy (≥ 2mc²) and annihilate into photons.…  ·  ## 3. Conceptual Relationships - **To Topic 110:** pair creation/annihilation is the particle–antiparticle machinery. - **To Topic 109:** quark binding energy underlies nuclear mass and stability. - **To Topic 116:** the Big Bang produced the particle families in the first seconds.
